card.name: Sheriff Pals
card.subject: The man in a cowboy hat tips it politely while the pig, in a cowboy hat that fits over its ears, holds a tin mug of coffee beside him, both in front of a saloon.
card.hero_colors: brown hats, pink pig, tin grey mug
card.surface_or_setting: a boardwalk in front of a saloon

card.name: Ranch Hands
card.subject: The cow wears a red bandana, and the rooster wears a tiny cowboy hat with a hole for its comb, standing on a hay bale next to the cow and sharing a bucket of oats.
card.hero_colors: white and black cow, orange rooster, red bandana, tan hat
card.surface_or_setting: a hay bale on a ranch yard

card.name: Tea Time
card.subject: The man in a top hat bows politely and hands a tea cup to the pig, who wears a straw bonnet and holds her saucer with both hands.
card.surface_or_setting: garden lawn with a small tea table

card.name: Grand Ball
card.subject: The sheep and the cow dance a waltz in a ballroom, the sheep in a tiny bow tie and the cow in a ribbon bonnet, both smiling.

card.name: Cake Clue
card.subject: The man in a trench coat and fedora holds a magnifying glass over an empty cake plate with a few crumbs, while the rooster beside him lifts a press camera to photograph the plate.
card.hero_colors: tan trench coat, grey fedora, orange rooster, white plate, black camera
card.surface_or_setting: a wooden office floor with a table

card.name: Hoofprint Clue
card.subject: The sheep and the cow each hold a magnifying glass and lean in to study one muddy hoofprint on the floor between them.
card.hero_colors: white fleece, dark grey face, white and black cow, orange muzzle, brown mud
card.backdrop_colors: grass green barn yard with a blue sky
card.surface_or_setting: a barn floor of packed straw
